about: Curated stops for the South Central legs (missing roads pass, 2026-11-23), placed by cargo tools osm-stops --stops. Started from the stops the region's existing legs (Oklahoma, Kansas, Missouri and Arkansas) carry with a position and a source, so a stop on a shared road lands on a new leg too; heading for those was derived from the leg's own direction of travel at the stop where the old leg placed them on one side. Stops for the new legs were added from the OpenStreetMap planet file of 2026-11-16: named chain truck stops and travel centers within 0.3 mile of the road, named rest areas, and named diesel stations within 0.15 mile of the road, at most one diesel station per 12 miles where nothing else stood; QuikTrip and Buc-ee's are left out (the game screens QuikTrip as a convenience store, and Buc-ee's is tagged hgv=no). Side from a name (Westbound, Eastbound).

truck_access.about: Stops added in this pass whose tractor-trailer access was read from OpenStreetMap's hgv tag, and those where it is assumed with the reason in source: rest areas and chain truck stops with no hgv tag, and town diesel stations, which are marked bobtail only. The stops carried over from the region's existing legs keep their own sources.
